# A Jew — Breslov Torah Library

> The largest online Breslov Torah library. 240+ sacred Jewish texts, 26,510+ pages in Hebrew with English translations.

**URL:** https://ajew.org
**Languages:** English, Hebrew (bilingual)
**RSS:** https://ajew.org/rss.xml
**Sitemap:** https://ajew.org/sitemap-index.xml
**llms-full.txt:** https://ajew.org/llms-full.txt — complete AI-readable content index

## Key Sections

- **Library** — https://ajew.org/reader — 240+ texts
- **Parsha** — https://ajew.org/parsha — 54 portions, 2,911 Breslov connections
- **Search** — https://ajew.org/search-enhanced — 26,510+ pages
- **Daily Study** — https://ajew.org/daily-study
- **Topics** — https://ajew.org/topics
- **Healing Words** — https://ajew.org/healing-words
- **Torah GPS** — https://ajew.org/torah-gps
- **Chain of Light** — https://ajew.org/chain-of-light
- **Saba Says** — https://ajew.org/saba-says
- **Chat** — https://ajew.org/chat
- **Speak & Learn** — https://ajew.org/speak

## Key Texts

- Likutay Moharan — 411 teachings
- Likutay Halachos — halachic commentary
- Likutay Tefilos — prayers
- Sipurey Maasiyos — 13 Stories
- Zohar HaKadosh — 8 volumes
- Talmud Bavli — 39 tractates
- Mishna — 6 orders
- Rambam Mishneh Torah — 14 books
- Tanach — Torah, Nevi'im, Ketuvim
- Petek Nanach — Letter from Heaven
